title: Harriet the Spy
author: Louise Fitzhugh
current_text: Harriet the Spy was challenged at a 1983 school-board meeting in Xenia, Ohio; proponents of the ban said it taught children to “lie, spy, back-talk, and curse,” but the board voted to keep the books in the school libraries.

sources.quote: Along with Are You There God?, Blubber, and Where the Sidewalk Ends, the book was challenged at a 1983 school-board meeting in Xenia, Ohio.
